title: Eton Pharmaceuticals to Participate at 2026 Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference
author: Na
description: Eton Pharmaceuticals announced record Q2 2026 revenue with product sales of $37.6 million, representing 99% year-over-year growth. The company reported GAAP EPS of $0.35 and non-GAAP EPS of $0.43, with EBITDA of $14.1 million. Additionally, Eton expanded its infantile hemangioma franchise by acquiring U.S. rights to ASN-001, a late-stage product candidate targeting moderate infantile hemangiomas, complementing its existing HEMANGEOL product.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company demonstrated exceptional financial performance with 99% revenue growth year-over-year, strong profitability metrics (positive EPS and EBITDA), and strategic expansion through acquisition of a complementary late-stage product candidate, indicating robust business momentum and growth trajectory.

title: Eton Pharmaceuticals Expands Infantile Hemangioma Franchise with Acquisition of U.S. Rights to Late-Stage Product Candidate ASN-001
author: Na
description: Eton Pharmaceuticals has licensed U.S. rights to ASN-001 (timolol topical gel) from Auson Pharmaceuticals for treating moderate infantile hemangiomas. Phase II/III trial results showed 56% elimination rates at week 24 with twice-daily dosing versus 15% for placebo. The company plans to submit an NDA in H2 2027 with potential approval and launch in 2028, targeting an estimated 20,000-30,000 patients annually and positioning ASN-001 as a complementary product to its existing HEMANGEOL therapy.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Eton is acquiring a late-stage product candidate with strong Phase II/III efficacy data (56% vs 15% placebo), targeting a large patient population (20,000-30,000 annually), and leveraging existing commercial infrastructure. The acquisition is expected to complement their existing HEMANGEOL product and potentially become their largest revenue-generating product, demonstrating strategic expansion in their core rare disease focus.

title: Eton Pharmaceuticals to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, August 13, 2026
author: Not Specified
description: Eton Pharmaceuticals announced it will report second quarter 2026 financial results on August 13, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. The company also announced a Prior Approval Supplement submission to expand KHINDIVI's indication for a larger pediatric patient population and expanded its rare disease portfolio through commercialization rights to IMPAVIDO®.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is expanding its commercial portfolio through FDA submissions for label expansion (KHINDIVI) and acquiring commercialization rights to an additional rare disease treatment (IMPAVIDO). These strategic moves indicate growth initiatives and expansion of their rare disease treatment offerings, which are positive developments for the company's future revenue and market position.

title: Eton Pharmaceuticals Expands Rare Disease Portfolio Through Acquisition of U.S. Commercialization Rights to HEMANGEOL® (propranolol hydrochloride) Oral Solution
author: Globe Newswire
description: Eton Pharmaceuticals announced the acquisition of U.S. commercialization rights to HEMANGEOL® (propranolol hydrochloride) oral solution from Pierre Fabre Medicament. HEMANGEOL is the only FDA-approved treatment for infantile hemangiomas requiring systemic therapy. The acquisition marks Eton's achievement of ten commercial products and is expected to be accretive to 2026 earnings. Commercialization begins May 1st with distribution through Eton's patient support program offering $0 co-pay assistance.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The acquisition expands Eton's rare disease portfolio to ten commercial products, achieving a long-held strategic goal. The deal is expected to be accretive to 2026 earnings and adds an FDA-approved orphan drug with an estimated 5,000-10,000 annual patients in the U.S., strengthening the company's market position in rare diseases.

title: Eton Pharmaceuticals Announces U.S. FDA Approval for DESMODA™ (desmopressin acetate) Oral Solution
author: Na
description: Eton Pharmaceuticals announced FDA approval of DESMODA (desmopressin acetate) Oral Solution for central diabetes insipidus treatment. The product, launching March 9th, is the first FDA-approved oral liquid formulation enabling precise dosing without tablet splitting. Eton projects peak annual sales of $30-50 million with patent protection through 2044, targeting over 13,000 U.S. patients including 3,000-4,000 pediatric patients.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: FDA approval of a first-in-class product with significant commercial potential ($30-50M peak sales), long patent protection through 2044, addresses unmet clinical needs in rare disease treatment, and leverages existing commercial infrastructure for market penetration.
